female.normalRule: Independent complete-Face absolute-shape area weighted normals at active triangle neighborhood only, preserved original authored normals elsewhere. Combine active domains before normals.

male.normalRule: Independent complete-Face absolute-shape area weighted normals at active triangle neighborhood only, preserved original authored normals elsewhere. Combine active domains before normals.

limits: Only original female/male and one +1% endpoint.
Paused direct expressionManager/applier diagnostics are not product UI blink/gaze playback.
Zero eyelid gap or sampled iris occlusion is not a visual pass.
Source normal CPU agreement does not establish authored-lighting continuity: inspect half/full and unilateral blink.
Same-context page reopen is local draft persistence, not a server.
Recorded frame times are not target-PC performance; 2fps review is not continuous human acceptance.
